messages:
anna: Quick heads-up — ran the profiler on the /chat/structured route and found a consistent ~8-12ms/token overhead when structured-output validation is enabled. Dashboard updated: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/structured-output
raja: ugh. is that across all models or only long-seq workloads?
mike: Looks like it's most visible on 2k+ context windows but present even at 512 tokens. I pulled a couple traces. sample flamegraph: 
```
# kernel time breakdown (ms)
attention: 3.1
kv-cache-lookup: 0.6
structured-validate: 9.5
batch-scheduler: 1.2
io: 0.8
```
sophie: Interesting — structured-validate looks dominant. Is that on the hot path (per-token) or batched post-processing?
anna: It's in the hot path. We call the validator per-chunk to apply schema asserts during generation, so it adds to per-token latency. We intentionally do validation earlier to fail fast on invalid tool outputs.
raja: Can we gate it behind a per-route flag so only routes that need strong schema checks pay the cost? And add metrics to split token latency into validation vs serving?
mike: I already added a PromQL query to separate token-level buckets: 
```
sum by (route,stage) (rate(token_latency_ms_bucket[5m]))
```
That feeds the new per-route KPI panel (see panel id 7).
infra-bot: [alert] perf-regression detected on route="/chat/structured" p95 token latency increased by 18% over baseline at 2026-03-18T15:01:09Z
sophie: For dashboards, can we expose: total tokens, tokens_validated, avg_validation_ms, validation_retries? Right now retries from validator aren't correlated with traces.
raja: Also investigate kernel selection: I noticed that during some bursts the runtime switches to a generic kernel (less optimized) due to sequence-length variance which increases tail. That amplifies validation overhead. We should tag traces with kernel_id.
anna: Good call. I'll add kernel_id & validation_stage tags to the trace span and update the dashboard panels. Also adding a small A/B: validation-eager vs validation-lazy for 10% of traffic.
mike: For the A/B we should measure quality regressions — add automated evals: take 200 recent prompts and compare parse failure rate. Basic script: 
```
python tools/validate_eval.py --route /chat/structured --samples 200 --variant eager
```
raja: If validation-lazy moves validation off the hot path, we need a fallback on detect-invalid -> sync rollback to post-hoc correction. That will add complexity but may pay off.
sophie: Ops ask: please add per-route billing tags when gating validation, otherwise cost dashboards will misattribute increased GPU time to model runtime instead of validation CPU.
anna: On it. Action items: 1) anna add kernel_id + validation_stage tags to spans (ETA today). 2) mike add validation metrics panel + PromQL (ETA tomorrow). 3) raja prototype route-level gate and A/B switch (ETA end of week). 4) sophie add billing tagging to rule (ETA tomorrow).
raja: I'll also run a quick profiler to see alloc/copy overhead from validator, maybe we can micro-opt the validator code to avoid per-token JSON serialization.
mike: FYI I saw a small spike in retry count correlated with spike in queue depth — might be backpressure causing repeated validation attempts. Adding a retry counter metric now.
anna: Thanks team. If anyone wants to pair on the validator micro-optimizations ping me. I'll post a short writeup of the dashboard panels once they're stable. :thumbsup:
